text: The Nationally Determined Contribution Information Management System Upgrade (NDC‑IMS upgrade) in Papua New Guinea is an initiative led by the Climate Change and Development Authority (CCDA) to enhance the country's climate transparency and NDC implementation. The upgrade focuses on improving the monitoring, reporting, and verification (MRV) systems to track and report on quantitative mitigation and adaptation targets as part of the Enhanced Transparency Framework under the Paris Agreement. The initiative is supported by the Regional Pacific NDC Hub and other international partners, aiming to prepare for the first Biennial Transparency Report (BTR1) and align with sectoral roadmaps, particularly in AFOLU and REDD+.
